The '''Nova Vaults of Kakitai bel Toyouin''' were a series of treasure-filled chambers buried deep beneath the surface of [[Tartaglia]]. The crust of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was riddled with chasms and gorges, the result of countless excavation attempts. The vaults remained hidden for millennia, and some had begun to question their existence.
